skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK(+10) DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in the entire row with a 4-hit combo, dealing 30% ATK(+2) DMG per hit, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 80% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in the entire row with a 4-hit combo, dealing 30% ATK(+2) DMG per hit, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target and a 50% chance on enemies in the main target's row for 2 turns (DoT equal to 80% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). When an enemy's [Burn] expires, inflicts [Burn] on a random enemy target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 50% ATK).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). When an enemy's [Burn] expires, inflicts [Burn] on a random enemy target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 70% ATK).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). When an enemy's [Burn] expires, inflicts [Burn] on a random enemy target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 80% ATK).

effects.desc: Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
